name: Your word, by mail
title: Your word, by mail: what you promised somebody by email, by a day, in the morning brief when the day comes, unless you have written to them since
aliases: did i send what i promised

events.opened: You pressed Open the email on a promise of yours in the morning brief
events.context: You opened What you wrote on a promise of yours in the morning brief
events.done: You pressed Mark as done on a promise of yours in the morning brief

runs.shown: Rouh put a promise you made by email, due or late, in the morning brief

permissions: reads your sent mail of the last three weeks in every mailbox you gave Rouh, with GET alone, when the morning brief opens (kept a quarter of an hour)
looks for a later email from you to the same person, to leave out what you may have sent
keeps the promises you put away in your own settings
touches.remove: Turn the switch my_word off on its row in Evolution, Mutations, and the section is gone and the route refuses; to remove it for good revert night 36's commit for it (rouh/my_word.py, the brief_my_word route and its lines in rouh/web/brief.py and rouh/project/urls.py, drawMyWord and its helpers in briefpage.js, this manifest) and delete the user setting my_word. rouh/mail_promises.py is shared with Promised to you by mail and If it does not come.
